title: Aircraft Service Attendants
description: Service aircraft with fuel. May de-ice aircraft, refill water and cooling agents, empty sewage tanks, service air and oxygen systems, or clean and polish exterior.

tasks.text: Inspect aircraft components to locate cracks, breaks, leaks, or other problems.
Apply de-icing fluid to aircraft from baskets lifted by truck-mounted cranes.
Change aircraft oil, coolant, or other fluids.
Clean aircraft interiors by picking up waste, wiping down windows, or vacuuming.
Climb ladders to reach aircraft surfaces to be cleaned.
Empty aircraft lavatory systems or refill them with sanitizer fluid.
Load baggage or cargo for crew or passengers.
Refuel aircraft using hoses connected to fuel trucks.
Remove exhaust stains from aircraft using cleaning fluids.
Tow aircraft to gates or hangars using tugs, tractors, or other vehicles.
Wash the aircraft exteriors using lifts, cranes, detergent, or other equipment.
Guide aircraft to designated areas using hand signals, batons, or other methods.
Radio to flight dispatchers or other personnel to discuss incoming or outgoing aircraft.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Facilities management software
skills.def: Software to track, monitor, or analyze a facility's assets, space availability, or tenant information. Examples: Access Software AIRPAX, Maintenance information databases, Maintenance planning software, Maintenance record software.

skills.name: Information retrieval or search software
skills.def: Software to efficiently search or access data from sources such as large collections of documents. Examples: Computerized aircraft log manager CALM, Technical manual database software.
